_comment: GGUF artifacts a node may serve. Data, not code: adding a model to the
fleet is a catalog change plus a signed daemon release, so the set of
weights an operator's machine will run is reviewable in a diff.
sha256 is the pin. The daemon verifies it after download AND before
load, and refuses to serve a file that does not match. Artifacts are
fetched from MESHEMBED_GGUF_MIRROR, never from a third-party host: the
pin only means something if we can serve those exact bytes for the life
of a fleet generation, which an upstream repository does not promise.
min_ram_gb is measured against AVAILABLE memory, not installed, so a
workstation whose owner is using it does not get handed a model it
cannot fit.
Every entry must pass both onboarding gates (MODEL_ONBOARDING_POLICY.md):
no torch/torchvision surface, and no code executed at load time. GGUF
satisfies the second by construction.
PENDING MIRRORING -- the Phase 1 catalog in LLM_INFERENCE_DESIGN.md par.3
also names salamandra-7b-instruct and mistral-7b-instruct. They are not
listed here because no digest has been verified for them yet: the
artifacts must first be mirrored and pinned. Writing an unverified sha256
into this file would defeat the entire point of the file. The 7B listed
below is Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct: same family as the 0.5B, licence known,
digest verified against the bytes that were measured (docs/LLM_INTERACTIVE_PHASE2.md par.3).

models.note: Apache-2.0. Small enough for any office machine and for CPU-only nodes. MEASURED 2026-09-19/20 on realistic documents: classification 26.7%, extraction 20.0%, redaction recall 0.285 -- not usable for any of them. Its one measured strength is copying from clean, labelled documents (98.3% extraction where the answer sits after a label). Use it for that, or as a cheap first pass with escalation on invalid shape; do not route classification or extraction to it by default.

Apache-2.0 (Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct, Q4_K_M by bartowski). The working tier. MEASURED 2026-09-20 on realistic documents: classification 83.3%, extraction 73.3% when every schema field carries a description (37.9% without -- describe your fields), and NOT ready for de-identification (redaction recall 0.094: it answers 'nothing here' on documents holding a name, an email and a phone). Roughly 3x the 7B's token rate at a fraction of its memory; about 20 input tokens/s effective on a 2014 Xeon, so a 6,000-token document is minutes.

Apache-2.0 (Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, Q4_K_M quant by bartowski, digest verified 2026-09-13 and measured: 4.4 tok/s resident on a 2014 Xeon, memory-bandwidth bound, ~5 GB resident -- hence min_ram_gb 8 of AVAILABLE memory). Accuracy on realistic documents NOT measured for this tier. Do not pair it with the 0.5B for routing: the 0.5B's routing accuracy is 27-43%.
